metadata.question: Did Cairns, Queensland receive more rainfall than Cooktown, Queensland (-15.475923, 145.248920) between January 31 and February 4, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS or GPM/IMERG precipitation data for both locations - Date range: January 31 to February 4, 2025 - Locations: Cairns (need to find coordinates) and Cooktown (-15.475923, 145.248920) - Cairns coordinates: approximately -16.9186, 145.7781 2. Masking strategy: - Precipitation data typically doesn't need cloud masking - Simply sum total rainfall over the period for each location 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Check if collection has images (C1 if empty) - Check if pixel count > 0 (C2 if zero valid pixels) - Check if result is valid number and within reasonable range (0-1000mm for a few days) (C3 if invalid) - If both values are valid, compare: A if Cairns > Cooktown, B if Cairns <= Cooktown ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cairns = ee.Geometry.Point([145.7781, -16.9186]); const cooktown = ee.Geometry.Point([145.248920, -15.475923]); const startDate = '2025-01-31'; const endDate = '2025-02-05'; // Exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily Precipitation const precip = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const imageCount = precip.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images in collection: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data available for this period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate total rainfall for both locations const totalPrecip = precip.sum(); // Calculate for Cairns const cairnsStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: cairns, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // Calculate for Cooktown const cooktownStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: cooktown, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const cairnsRainfall = cairnsStats.precipitation_sum; const cairnsCount = cairnsStats.precipitation_count; const cooktownRainfall = cooktownStats.precipitation_sum; const cooktownCount = cooktownStats.precipitation_count; console.log(`Cairns: ${cairnsRainfall !== null ? cairnsRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm, Pixels: ${cairnsCount}`); console.log(`Cooktown: ${cooktownRainfall !== null ? cooktownRainfall.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm, Pixels: ${cooktownCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (cairnsCount === 0 || cooktownCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels found for one or both locations."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (cairnsRainfall === null || cooktownRainfall === null || isNaN(cairnsRainfall) || isNaN(cooktownRainfall) || cairnsRainfall < 0 || cooktownRainfall < 0 || cairnsRainfall > 2000 || cooktownRainfall > 2000) { console.log("Invalid rainfall values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Compare rainfall amounts if (cairnsRainfall > cooktownRainfall) { console.log("Cairns received more rainfall than Cooktown."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Cairns did not receive more rainfall than Cooktown."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
